review.description: Contributors now inspect bounded read-only reports with exact next argv and actual deduplicated old/current anchors, plus typed open-gap inventory. V2 gap IDs/kind/severity/owner/next verification remain explicit and v1 historical reasons stay untyped. UI-only mixed decisions separate pinned initial adoption from new behavior without overriding product-flow policy.
review.implementation: Inspected CLI report/gaps dispatch, pure reporting and gap helpers, version-aware schema/rendering/history support, focused module APIs and old/new operational module fingerprints. Legacy CLI stdout/flags and public patch/callback defaults remain compatible. Mixed UI decisions cover each direct contract and keep path/anchor adoption eligibility pinned; current behavior needs related code/tests. Pure browser-controller option gates are a separate operational input; Make and release verification now include their Node test. The approved pilot mode is documented without changing the default native path or granting arbitrary session access.
review.tests: Read five actual CLI/v2 integration methods, eleven reporting methods including coverage-group-only limits/anchors, nine gap schema/migration/report methods, five module compatibility/fingerprint methods, four fixed-seed combined cases and seven mixed-policy methods. They assert real selected argv/read-only output, strict metadata/global IDs/owners, preserved reasons and history, old/current anchor scope, seeded rename/retirement/Unicode/index combinations and per-contract cochange/adoption boundaries. Reports themselves record no verification success. Seven pure browser option methods reject unsafe/ambiguous options and keep privacy defaults; no browser/authentication is invoked by them.
